title: VfxAssetCandidate
description: Metadata schema for classifying and processing Mega Pack PNG sequence assets during R1 intake. All Mega Pack source paths are relative to <MEGA_PACK_ROOT>, which is a configurable external directory outside public/assets/. No commercial source files are copied into the repository.

candidateId.description: Unique identifier for this candidate. Use UNASSIGNED_PENDING_R1 when no verified source asset exists yet.

sourceCollection.description: Collection or pack name within the Mega Pack. Use UNASSIGNED_PENDING_R1 until R1 indexing.

sourcePath.description: Relative path from <MEGA_PACK_ROOT> to the source asset directory. Use UNASSIGNED_PENDING_R1 until R1 indexing.

sourceFilename.description: Source filename or filename pattern. Use UNASSIGNED_PENDING_R1 until R1 indexing.

frameCount.description: Number of PNG frames in the source sequence. Set to 0 when UNASSIGNED_PENDING_R1.

frameDimensions.description: Source frame pixel dimensions. Set to 0x0 when UNASSIGNED_PENDING_R1.

alphaAvailability.description: Whether the source PNGs include an alpha channel for transparency.

animationDuration.description: Estimated total animation duration in seconds at intended playback FPS. Set to 0 when PENDING_SOURCE_INSPECTION.

loopSuitability.description: Whether the animation is suitable for looping or is a one-shot impact.

visualFamily.description: Primary visual family classification for the asset.

element.description: Elemental affinity of the visual effect.

direction.description: Primary motion direction of the visual effect.

impactLocation.description: Where the visual impact is anchored in the combat scene.

targetShape.description: The area shape the visual effect should communicate.

intensity.description: Visual intensity scale matching RPGThreeJS presentation tiers.

playbackMode.description: Runtime playback mode. 'once' for one-shot impacts, 'loop' for persistent effects. This is a metadata field only — no runtime code changes during R0.

supportVsOffensive.description: Whether the effect reads as an offensive impact or a support/buff effect.

groundVsTarget.description: Whether the effect is anchored to the ground, follows the target, or is airborne.

cameraCompatibility.description: Camera projection compatibility for the sprite sheet.

classificationTier.description: Processing classification tier determined during R1 intake.

estimatedRPGThreeJSUsage.description: Estimated RPGThreeJS usage category for this candidate.

processingType.description: Processing pipeline step required to convert the source PNG sequence into a runtime spritesheet.

r1VerificationStatus.description: R1 intake verification status. UNASSIGNED_PENDING_R1 until the Mega Pack is purchased and indexed.
